over_budget_by_role_sum adds a role's PrompTugal-titled sessions (old, replaced and new); the budgets are the website's board/budgets.json of 16 Nov, per day, old names, a measure and not a reason to stop an agent. The sessions' totals run from creation (22:48Z 25 Nov to 21:17Z 26 Nov), longer than a calendar day for three of them.
Worker restarts are counted from worker_epoch, which rose in almost every session since 15:54; whether a restart is a reset of context is not shown by usage data (context fell only in abp and dev).
